newsitem.title: ROMANIA: New bidders contest Romania GSM tender.
newsitem.headline: New bidders contest Romania GSM tender.

text.p: Two unsuccessful bidders in a lucrative contract to install and operate a GSM mobile telephone network in Romania denounced on Friday a tender awarded to French and U.S. firms.
A consortium led by Stet Spa of Italy and a local branch of Telefonica de Espana called for the outcome of the tender awarded last week to be reconsidered.
"We hereby officially request an independent review of the underlying evaluation procedures...," the Blutel consortium said in a letter to the Communications Ministry.
Earlier this week, another consortium, Zephir led by telecom groups Motorola Inc of the U.S. and Tele Danmark of Denmark, filed a similar complaint.
The ministry offered no comment on the challenges to its decision last week to award two licences to AirTouch Communications Inc of the United States and France Telecom.

The announcement of the winners in the long-delayed tender came on the eve of the run-off to presidential elections in which reformist Emil Constantinescu defeated ex-Communist Ion Iliescu. Parliamentary elections were won two weeks earlier by centrists who back the new president.
Zephir's submission challenged the way the Monaco-based La Compagnie de Conseil was appointed by the ministry to review the tenders.
